author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices counting to three, a pattern that moves up, fingers in order and playing two parts together, using a very old round about scurrying mice.

classes.title: Five little mouse holes
classes.goal: Hear the song, find C by the two black keys and place five fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: Using the two black keys as a sign to find C

classes.parentPrompt: Point to two black keys, then help your child rest the thumb on C, fingers beside it.
classes.childAction: Thumb on C, then one finger in each mouse hole up to G.
classes.bridge: Five white keys are five mouse holes; one finger peeks into each.

intro.caption: One finger in each hole
intro.parentCue: say one to five as each finger lands

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Say the finger number for each key

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding C and placing five fingers.

classes.title: Three mice, three notes
classes.goal: Learn the first line: three mice, three notes, three fingers walking down.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three words, three notes, three fingers: one for each

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up three fingers and fold one down for each note: three, blind, mice.
classes.childAction: Play E, D, C with fingers 3, 2, 1. Count the mice!
classes.bridge: Three mice tiptoe down three keys to the left, one key each.

intro.caption: Three mice, three notes
intro.parentCue: hold up three fingers and count together

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: matching three words to three notes.

classes.title: Same steps, higher up
classes.goal: Learn 'see how they run' and hear it walk down like the mice line, but higher.

mathTarget.parentLine: A shape we know, moved higher up the keys

classes.parentPrompt: Play the mice line, then this line, and ask: 'Do they sound alike?'
classes.childAction: Play G, F, F, E: walking down again, higher up.
classes.bridge: The mice climb up to a higher shelf and walk down the same way.

intro.caption: The mice climb higher
intro.parentCue: ask your child if the lines sound alike

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting a pattern that moves higher.

classes.title: You hold the mouse hole
classes.goal: The grown-up plays the high running part; the child plays the G that ends each run.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different parts fit together into one song

classes.parentPrompt: You play the high running part. Nod to your child for the G, G at each end.
classes.childAction: Listen to the mice run, then play G, G with finger five.
classes.bridge: The mice scurry high on the right; G is the hole they dash into.

intro.caption: The mice run up high
intro.parentCue: you play the running part; nod for each G

games.caption: Hear the mice scurry
games.parentCue: Scurry your fingers on your child's arm

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing your part while another plays theirs.

classes.title: Four, three, two, one
classes.goal: Learn the last line, four fingers walking down in order to home C.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fingers in order, counting down: four, three, two, one

classes.parentPrompt: Count down 'four, three, two, one' with your child, like a little rocket landing.
classes.childAction: Play F, E, D, C with fingers 4, 3, 2, 1.
classes.bridge: As three blind mice: four steps down, and the mice are home on C.

intro.caption: Count down: four, three, two, one
intro.parentCue: count down aloud as they play

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: moving fingers in order, counting down.

classes.title: Same at both ends
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and hear that it ends the way it began.

mathTarget.parentLine: The song begins and ends with the same three notes

classes.parentPrompt: At the very end, gasp and say: 'The mice are back!' Ask what came in between.
classes.childAction: Play slowly; wave hello to the mice line at the end.
classes.bridge: Three mice walk out, run around, then walk home the same way.

intro.caption: Where do the mice end up?
intro.parentCue: ask your child at the very end

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a song end the way it started.

classes.title: Long, short-short
classes.goal: Practise 'see how they run' slowly, with its little skip on 'how they'.

mathTarget.parentLine: One note twice as long as the next, like a skip

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'see how they run' slowly, clapping once on each word, before your child plays.
classes.childAction: Play G, F, F, E slowly, skipping like a mouse.
classes.bridge: How-they is a mouse skip: a longer step, then a tiny hop.

intro.caption: Skip like a little mouse
intro.parentCue: clap the words slowly once together first

games.caption: Slowly: see how they run
games.parentCue: Say the words as they play

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: long notes and short notes in a skip.

classes.title: Tiptoe, even steps
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, with every big beat even, like tiptoeing mice.

mathTarget.parentLine: Every big beat the same length, never rushing

classes.parentPrompt: Tiptoe two fingers on your child's back on each big beat while they play.
classes.childAction: Play slowly, with even steps, like mice on tiptoe.
classes.bridge: Mice tiptoe evenly so nobody hears them: step, step, step.

intro.caption: Tiptoe like mice
intro.parentCue: tiptoe your fingers on their back on each beat

games.caption: Tap the tiptoe beat
games.parentCue: Count softly as your child taps

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing slowly with an even beat.

classes.title: Run with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music and keep going to the end.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping pace with the music, all the way to the end

classes.parentPrompt: Sing beside your child and play the high running part; if they slip, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music; keep going after a slip.
classes.bridge: You and the music scamper together, nose to tail.

intro.caption: Scamper with the music
intro.parentCue: sing beside your child and keep going

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping pace with the music to the end.

classes.title: Tiptoe and scurry show
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy: tiptoe softly, scurry fast, then tiptoe home.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing some parts calm and some parts busy

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the scurry part with energy, then clap and bow.
classes.childAction: Play softly for teddy, then bow when the mice are home.
classes.bridge: Soft notes tiptoe; quick notes scurry; the last C is home.

intro.caption: A mouse show for teddy!
intro.parentCue: sit teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing calm and busy parts of a song.
